record.field: Query customers with runtime-readable fields, relation filters and a fixed customer scope.
Read selected runtime-readable details for one customer.
Group and aggregate customers by runtime-readable stored fields.
Query sellable products with runtime-readable fields and filters.
Read selected runtime-readable details for one sellable product.
Count sellable products matching runtime-readable filters.
Group and aggregate sellable products by runtime-readable stored fields.
Query quotations and sales orders with runtime-readable fields and relation filters.
Read selected runtime-readable details for one quotation or sales order.
Count quotations and sales orders matching runtime-readable filters.
Group and aggregate quotations and sales orders by runtime-readable stored fields.
Prepare a customer with a name and optional contact details. Creation requires confirmation and the current user's customer maintenance permissions.
Preview changes to one accessible customer's name, phone, email, address, website or notes. Confirmation applies only permitted fields under the current user's permissions.
Legacy quick lookup limited to customer name, phone and email. Use the generic customer query, count or group tools for geography, relations and other fields.
Legacy quick lookup limited to product name or SKU. Use the generic product tools for other filters and statistics.
Legacy quick lookup limited to order number, customer or state. Use the generic sales order tools for other filters and statistics.
List accessible follow-up activities for one customer.
Prepare a customer follow-up activity assigned to the requesting employee. Create it only after confirmation.
Prepare a draft quotation from an accessible customer, products and quantities. Odoo computes prices and taxes after confirmation; the order remains a draft and is not sent to the customer.
Query customer lists and counts, create customers and edit permitted contact details.

Use the customer actions for actual ERP data. An empty customer search lists and counts accessible customers. Resolve the customer before editing. Prepare a preview immediately when a write request has enough details, and wait for confirmation before applying it. Never claim a record was saved before the action succeeds.
Query quotations and sales orders, find customers and products, and prepare sales order drafts.

Use the sales actions for actual ERP data. An empty sales order search lists and counts accessible quotations and orders. Resolve customer and products before preparing a draft. Prepare a preview when the request has enough details. Creation requires confirmation and must leave the order in draft; never confirm or send an order.
Customer queries, creation and editing, sales order drafts and follow-up workflows.

Use only the permitted sales tools. Prepare a preview when the request has enough details, then wait for human confirmation before applying changes. Customer and sales order searches may omit search terms to list and count accessible records. Never claim a record was saved before the action succeeds.
